day_shape: 52 items dominated by heavy Khamenei/IRIB Fatimah al-Zahra mourning cycle, Iranian navy claim of a tanker mine-strike in the Strait of Hormuz, CENTCOM touting 1.7bn barrels escorted, and Iran state TV naming RAF Fairford as a missile target; no UK Parliament, OFAC or IAEA output.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker and shipping
threads.summary: Iran's navy said an oil tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in the eastern Strait of Hormuz, per the Jerusalem Post. CENTCOM posted that over 1.7 billion barrels of crude have transited Hormuz under US protection, and the Jerusalem Post reported Iraq's PM secretly visited Tehran on 6 November over a Hormuz-bypass pipeline.

threads.label: Iranian threats and US pressure messaging
threads.summary: Iranian state TV said a modified Khorramshahr missile could reach RAF Fairford, while Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri responded to US Secretary of State remarks about Iranians having to 'eat' by accusing Washington of threatening starvation. The Jerusalem Post cited an Israeli expert saying Trump is sidelining Vance in favour of economic siege over new strikes, and Defa Press cited a YouGov poll putting UK opposition to war with Iran at 65%.

threads.label: Fatimah al-Zahra mourning cycle at Khamenei compound
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB pushed a sustained stream of posts from the fifth and final night of mourning for Fatimah al-Zahra, held near the tomb of Qasem Soleimani with Khamenei present. Coverage featured eulogies by Mehdi Rosouli and Morteza Taheri invoking 'vengeance and blood-seeking of the shaheed of Iran'.

threads.label: Iran domestic economy and fuel pressure
threads.summary: Iran International reported tighter petrol rationing with queues nationwide seven years after 'Bloody November', and Kayhan accusing the Pezeshkian government of fear-mongering while official data show prices up nearly 89% year-on-year. Defa Press quoted the oil refining CEO saying no new petrol decision has been made, and IRIB posted on bakery dual-fuel conversions.

threads.label: IRGC rebuttal and regional proxy signals
threads.summary: IRGC spokesman Mohebati called Israeli claims of attacks on Iranian cooling systems a 'threadbare scenario' and warned Paris against a false-flag trap. Defa Press carried Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claiming Saudi jets hit Yemen 72 times in 24 hours, and Lebanese MP Tony Franjieh prioritising liberation of occupied Lebanese territory.

events.summary_en: Blinken: Iran has emerged from the war in a stronger position in the region. Blinken at the twenty-fourth India Times Leadership Summit (HTLS), stating that the United States' aggressive war against Iran was an extremely unpleasant and unnecessary choice, said: any potential agreement will lead Washington to a nuclear agreement that will be no better than the previous agreement from which US President Donald Trump withdrew. What Iran ultimately accepts regarding its nuclear programme may not differ from the agreement (JCPOA) that Trump tore up, or will certainly not be better than it, and accepting this reality is very difficult for him.

events.title_en: Lebanese parliament representative: Current priority is the liberation of Lebanese occupied territories. Tony Franjieh, Lebanese parliament representative...
events.summary_en: Lebanese parliament representative: Current priority is the liberation of Lebanese occupied territories. Tony Franjieh, Lebanese parliament representative, said in an interview with the Al-Ahd news agency: the priority at this stage is the liberation of territory from Israeli occupation, restoring sovereignty over all Lebanese territories and supporting our country's army. Unity among Lebanese and avoiding division to confront the Israeli enemy and strengthen the domestic front is essential. Controversial issues can be addressed after the enemy's withdrawal from southern Lebanon and the extension of the army's control over the entire country, just as the issue of arms can be dealt with within the framework of national dialogue free from internal divisions.

events.title: Seven years after ‘Bloody November,’ Iran rations gasoline it dares not reprice
events.summary: Seven years after a fuel price rise set off one of the deadliest crackdowns in the Islamic Republic’s history, Iran is rationing gasoline more tightly, with lines at stations across the country, but it still dares not touch the subsidized price.
